about: The screen-control ask set (2026-11-13, the user's goal: _chatbot is very smart to help user control screen_ -- font size, colour or style of the Bible showing, another version added to it, a transition, the display checked, screens grouped, _everything in screen control_). Asked by scripts/screen-run.mjs through the real help window of a SCRATCH development instance whose screens are all on VIRTUAL displays (a screen shown there draws on no monitor). Set up first: John 3:16 (KJV) on screen 0 and shown; screen 1 hidden, on a second virtual display; a second Bible installed -- `{otherBible}` in an ask is its language, the English name the screen tool's `read` gives the first installed Bible that is not the KJV, so the set names no language of its own. `check` is a JavaScript expression over `b` (the screen state before the ask) and `a` (after) -- `style`, `effects[id]`, `screens[id]`, `count` -- that is true when the ask was DONE; a read has none and is graded by its words. Each scenario is a tab of its own, its asks follow-ups in it.

asks.text: Make the Bible verse on the screen bigger
asks.expect: the on-screen Bible text's font size goes up, said in a sentence

asks.text: Change its colour to yellow
asks.expect: the Bible text colour becomes a yellow

asks.text: Make it bold and give it a shadow
asks.expect: bold on and a shadow drawn

asks.text: Centre it
asks.expect: the Bible text is centred

asks.text: Undo that
asks.expect: the centring is taken back, the rest kept

asks.text: The verse on the projector is too small, people at the back can't read it
asks.expect: the font size goes up (a complaint is an ask)

asks.text: Give the Bible text a thick black outline
asks.expect: an outline, dark, thicker than before

asks.text: Put the lines of the verse closer together
asks.expect: the line height goes down

asks.text: Set the Bible text style back to normal
asks.expect: the style is plain again (the panel's Reset keeps the size)

asks.text: Add the {otherBible} Bible to the verse on the screen so both versions show
asks.expect: the passage on screen 0 shows KJV and the second Bible

asks.text: Which Bible versions are on the screen now?
asks.expect: names both versions, read off the screens

asks.text: Line the two versions up verse by verse
asks.expect: Line Sync on for screen 0

asks.text: Take the {otherBible} one off again
asks.expect: only the KJV left on screen 0

asks.text: Change the slide transition to zoom
asks.expect: the Slide transition of the screen(s) is zoom

asks.text: Turn the background transition off
asks.expect: the Background transition is none

asks.text: What transition does each screen use now?
asks.expect: per screen, the three transitions, read and not guessed

asks.text: Check the display: which monitor is each screen on?
asks.expect: screen 0 on Virtual Display 1, screen 1 on Virtual Display 2

asks.text: Move screen 1 to Virtual Display 1
asks.expect: screen 1's display is Virtual Display 1

asks.text: Is anything showing on the projector right now?
asks.expect: screen 0 showing John 3:16, screen 1 off

asks.text: Group screen 0 and screen 1 together
asks.expect: both screens share a colour note

asks.text: Lock screen 0 so nothing can change it by accident
asks.expect: screen 0 locked (its group with it)

asks.text: Unlock it
asks.expect: screen 0 unlocked

asks.text: Take screen 1 out of the group
asks.expect: screen 1 has no colour note

asks.text: Use stage 1 on screen 1
asks.expect: screen 1's stage number is 1

asks.text: Only work with screen 1 for now
asks.expect: screen 1 selected alone (Solo)

asks.text: Select both screens again
asks.expect: both screens selected

asks.text: Take the Bible off screen 0
asks.expect: the long-text layer of screen 0 cleared, the screen still on
